data.gender_notes: Mutazz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Taza', which means to reward or compensate. In Islamic history, Mutazz refers to someone who is rewarded or compensated for their good deeds in both this world and the next. The name Mutazz carries the meaning “Reward, Compensation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mutazz usually hope their child will grow to embody reward, compensation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes reward for good deeds in the hereafter.
data.etymology: Mutazz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reward, Compensation.”

in_arabic.name: مُعْتَز
in_arabic.meaning: مشتق از عزت، دارای قدرت و شوکت
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُعْتَز مشتق از ریشه عزّ (عَزَزَ) به معنای قدرت، شوکت و عزت است. این نام از اسماء الله الحسنیٰ نیست اما در فرهنگ اسلامی به عنوان یک نام پسندیده شناخته می‌شود. معنای این نام فردی است که دارای قدرت و شوکت است و مورد احترام و تکریم قرار دارد.

in_urdu.name: معتز
in_urdu.meaning: عزت و طاقت رکھنے والا، شوکت کا مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: معتز عربی زبان کے لفظ 'عزّ' سے مشتق ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں طاقت، شوکت اور عزت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک قابل احترام نام کے طور پر جانا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو طاقت ور اور شوکت رکھتا ہے، اور جسے عزت دی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुत्तज़
in_hindi.meaning: शक्ति और प्रतिष्ठा रखने वाला, सम्मानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुत्तज़ नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'عزّ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, प्रतिष्ठा और सम्मान। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक अच्छा नाम माना जाता है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो शक्ति और प्रतिष्ठा रखता है और जिसे सम्मान दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: معتز
in_pashto.meaning: د عزت او قدرت لرونکی، د شوکت خاوند
in_pashto.long_meaning: معتز د عربی ژبې د 'عزّ' کلمې څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې معنی یې دي قدرت، شوکت او عزت. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې د یو ښه نوم په توګه پېژندل شوی دی. مطلب یې دی هغه څوک چې د عزت او قدرت خاوند دی.

in_english.name: Mutazz
in_english.meaning: One who possesses power and dignity, respected
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mutazz is derived from the Arabic root 'عزّ' (ʿ-z-z), which conveys meanings of power, might, and dignity. Historically, names derived from this root have been used to denote leaders and esteemed personalities in Islamic history.

historical_references.reference: Mutazz ibn Abbas was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and the first qādī (judge) of Kufa. He was a cousin of Ali, the fourth Rashidun Caliph, and a distinguished scholar and jurist. Mutazz was appointed as the qādī of Kufa by Umar ibn Al-Khattab in 635 AD, and he continued in this position until his death in 653 AD. During his tenure as qādī, he established the first Islamic law school in Kufa, which became an important center for the study and development of Islamic law.

historical_references.reference: Mutazilites were a group of Islamic scholars and theologians who developed a philosophical and rationalist approach to understanding Islamic theology and metaphysics in the 8th and 9th centuries AD. Mutazilism was a response to the growing influence of Aristotelian and Neoplatonic thought in the Islamic world, and it emphasized the importance of reason and logic in understanding divine revelation. Mutazilites believed that God's attributes were similar to human attributes, but not identical, and they rejected the idea of God's physical presence in the world. Mutazz ibn Maslama was one of the leading figures of the Mutazilite movement and is known for his influential work, 'Al-Mowdha'ah' (The Refutation) in which he argued for the rationality of the Islamic faith.
